Re-runs after a parser fix and detects it was 'necessary but not sufficient' — confirming progress via re-run rather than assuming success.
After core suites green, runs rest of visible suite and pins down 'Only two visible failures remain', naming the specific failing behaviors — uses failing set to decide where to work next.
Re-runs the two targeted failed tests, then the full suite reaching '131/131' — an end-stage regression check confirming no net backslide.

reasoning: The agent consistently tracks aggregate pass/fail counts over time, notices remaining failures, re-runs to confirm net progress (step 49 catches an insufficient fix), and performs a targeted-then-full-suite regression check at the end (67-69), which exceeds anchor 5. It does not, however, maintain a structured per-feature ledger, account for newly-passing vs newly-broken after every change, or run cross-feature regression checks after each intermediate fix (mid-run it only re-runs the relevant suite), falling short of anchor 8. Behavior sits between 5 and 8, best matched at 6.
